_comment: Devin Stop hook for loops-nuxt. Place this under the 'hooks' key in your Devin user config (%APPDATA%\devin\config.json on Windows, ~/.config/devin/config.json elsewhere) or in a project's .devin/hooks.v1.json. It blocks the agent from stopping while .devin/.loops-nuxt-active exists.

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.devin/.loops-nuxt-active')) console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'loops-nuxt validation loop is active. Validate the change before stopping, or delete .devin/.loops-nuxt-active to bypass.'}));"
